system.description:
Mentally dominate a target through touch. Unwilling targets resist with an opposed Mind roll. Duration is typically one minute or a dramatic scene.

  • Level 1: Basic commands like 'turn around'
  • Level 2: Simple commands like 'go make me a sandwich'
  • Level 3: Complex commands like 'use a fake ID to smuggle an item'
  • Level 4: Can issue aggressive commands (e.g., attacking)
  • Level 5: Can erase brief memories
  • Level 6: Can erase or alter complex memories
